name: Nabi Miyabi
source:
Likes: rumors, cosplay, meat
Skills: business smile, fighting, shooting
Role: waitress at cafe EXIT

A woman who serves as a waitress at cafe EXIT in the New World. She excels in martial arts and also seems to be knowledgeable enough about the New World, but is also deep down a carefree and easy-going person, making her quite difficult to figure out. She has surprisingly loose-lipped and carelessly slips out important information, and so she is always frowned upon by [url=/c64130]Deguchi[/url].

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/miyabi.html]the official site[/url]]
